channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Court closes case against Bajd u Bejken over joke
item.description: Proceedings against popular podcast Bajd u Bejken declared extinct in the Magistrates’ Court, following formal agreement between parties to cease all references to social media personality Terry Muscat; in return Muscat agrees to not to refer to the podcast, its hosts, or their families in any media, including social media

item.title: NGO raises concerns over transfer of 20 dogs to Italian facility, animal commissioner to visit site
item.description: Animal rights NGO Vuci ghall-Annimali raises serious concerns over planned transfer of 20 dogs from Malta to a large shelter in Italy, calling for greater transparency and independent verification of the animals’ welfare conditions before they leave the island

item.title: Robert Abela meets with Pope Leo XIV
item.description: PM Abela visits the Vatican City on the 60-year anniversary of Malta-Holy See relations

item.title: MPs unlike ministers not duty-bound to tell the truth, Standards Commissioner says in report
item.description: Unlike ministers, MPs are not explicitly bound by an obligation of honesty under their code of ethics, with that obligation appearing only in the code applicable to ministers and parliamentary secretaries • Commissioner finds Claudette Buttigieg gave false picture on major waste treatment project in protest speech

item.title: Do not eat these eggs after 17 December
item.description: Eggs placed on market with wrong use-by date

item.title: Audit flags need for better coordination and data management in home-based elderly care
item.description: A National Audit Office report warns that gaps in coordination, planning and data management could undermine the sustainability of home-based medical and clinical services for Malta’s ageing population

item.title: Tribunal overturns police refusal of fireworks assistant licence
item.description: Administrative Review Tribunal rules that Commissioner of Police gave excessive weight to past reports when rejecting application by young fireworks enthusiast.

item.title: Tribunal partly upholds appeal over Las Palmas outside catering area at Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq
item.description: Administrative Review Tribunal annuls Lands Authority’s finding that Las Palmas is a kiosk, but upholds refusal to permit tables and chairs on public beach

item.title: Alexander Demarco will be Central Bank governor after parliaments green light
item.description: Central Bank of Malta Deputy Governor Alexander Demarco will replace Edward Scicluna at the helm of the bank when the latter’s term ends this month • Demarco obtains clearance from parliament’s Public Appointments Committee

item.title: Alex Borg at 100 days rally: ‘Change has started’
item.description: Alex Borg says PN government wants to take the country to the next stage and turn it into ‘a diamond in the Mediterranean’ at mass rally marking first 100 days
